# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities in Onicode privately through a
[GitHub security advisory](https://github.com/aislopware/onicode/security/advisories/new) on
`aislopware/onicode`. Do not open a public issue or PR, and please do not disclose the problem
publicly until we have had a reasonable opportunity to investigate and fix it.

Include the affected version, the surface (desktop, mobile, web, or the `onicode` server), steps to
reproduce, and the impact you observed.
